notice: The researchers' framework for coding students' reflections, copied from their coding sheet on 2026-11-19. Each criterion gives one point. The sheet's separate action plan column is not recorded; the action plan counts as State 3's criterion (DL-083).

criteria.label: 1 for why things did not go well
1 for competencies/knowledge they had to use
1 for applying learned competencies outside of prof life

1 for revolving around a main theme
